The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''28,793 before the Battle of Yavin''', also known as '''7,660 after the Tho Yor Arrival''', was a year in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic history]]. Around that time, a series of exploratory missions were undertaken on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sunspot (Tython system)|Sunspot]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]], the goal of which was to locate signs of previous habitation. The missions were ultimately unsuccessful.<ref name="DOTJ">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>
